requirements.heading: UNAUTHENTICATE Command
requirements.text: Servers MAY close the connection with an untagged BYE response if this preferably rare situation occurs.

requirements.heading: UNAUTHENTICATE Command
requirements.text: Servers MAY choose to advertise the UNAUTHENTICATE capability only after authentication has completed.

requirements.heading: Stateful Extensions
requirements.text: The connection state for the following list of IMAP extensions MUST be reset if both a) the specified extension is advertised and b) the UNAUTHENTICATE command is advertised and used.

requirements.heading: Stateful Extensions
requirements.text: o Cached identity information, such as group memberships, that are used to evaluate access control lists [RFC4314] MUST be reset.

requirements.heading: Stateful Extensions
requirements.text: o After an UNAUTHENTICATE command is issued, CONDSTORE servers [RFC7162] MUST behave as if no CONDSTORE-enabling command was issued.

requirements.heading: Security Considerations
requirements.text: As a result, IMAP server implementations of this extension MUST provide a way to disable it when it is not needed.
